info.title: yadg
info.description: Template-first document authoring from Markdown and prepared DOCX templates.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a starter YADG workspace without overwriting existing files.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate one YADG workspace; --yolo enables explicit best-effort recoveries.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --list
options.description: List discovered sources, templates, and references. [default: False]

options.name: --yolo
options.description: Explicit best-effort authoring with visible, deterministic degradations. [default: False]

commands.name: styles
commands.description: List Word styles, aliases, visibility, and numbering information.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: template
commands.description: Explain YADG presentation roles, examples, locations, and fallback choices.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build authored DOCX templates; --yolo enables explicit best-effort presentation recoveries.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --yolo
options.description: Explicit best-effort authoring with visible, deterministic degradations. [default: False]

commands.name: render
commands.description: Finalize authored DOCX files; --yolo may use the alternate supported renderer.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --renderer
options.description: Renderer ID: libreoffice (default) or word. [default: libreoffice]

options.name: --yolo
options.description: Explicit best-effort rendering; may use the alternate supported renderer. [default: False]

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Copy finalized DOCX files to an explicit delivery destination.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root; defaults to the current directory.
